_comment: Weapon stat lookup for mode=attack. Keyed by lowercased item name as it appears in inventory (landmark names from room topology, exactly as taken). Any carried item not listed here still works as an improvised weapon via the 'unarmed' fallback entry below -- nothing is required to be a real weapon to swing it, this is a household comedy dungeon, not a loot simulator. mode=attack auto-selects whichever carried item has the highest average damage (die_avg = (die_sides+1)/2 * die_count + bonus); ties keep whichever was found first. to_hit_bonus and damage_bonus add flat to the d20 attack roll and damage roll respectively.

weapons.flavor: You swing the sock. It is, somehow, still just a sock.
